raw_feedback_text: Issue - The assembly was not identified as a stiff component in combination with the shroud, similar to the GD-TT + GD-SH combo. EDIKB contains knowledge about such combinations about where GD-TT must be placed with respect to GD-SH to minimize strains, and lessons about GD-SH length that helps reduce strains. There was a judgement failure where the EDIKB knowledge node was not identified as useful.

structured_feedback.affected_requirement: GD-VLV + GD-SH concepts must retrieve analogous GD-SH + stiff-component EDIKB evidence before recommending valve placement or shroud length.
structured_feedback.affected_function: select valve position within shroud and shroud dimensions using available EDIKB evidence
structured_feedback.affected_behavior: avoid treating shroud-valve concepts as only roller-rideability geometry when they also create a stiff-component plus offset-shroud interaction
structured_feedback.affected_constraint: Do not dismiss GD-TT/GD-TP + GD-SH evidence as irrelevant merely because the stiff component is a valve; flag retrieval-usefulness judgement failure if omitted.
structured_feedback.pmap_issue: The solution centered the valve in the shroud without using existing EDIKB evidence on C1 stiff-body plus shroud placement and length effects.
